The WTO e-Learning Programme offers free online training on WTO Agreements and international trade. It is primarily intended for government officials from developing and least-developed country Members and Observers of the WTO, as our core objective is to support these countries in building trade-related capacity and participating more effectively in global trade. Courses are also available in self-study mode for anyone interested in gaining a deeper understanding of the multilateral trading system. Join today to explore our growing catalogue and strengthen your understanding of global trade. Sign in Learn more about us! FEATURED COURSES Ready to learn? Browse through this month’s selected courses and discover new opportunities to advance your skills. Development Assistance Aspects of Cotton and Introduction to World Cotton Day This third course in the Cotton course series explains how the WTO supports cotton development assistance, introduces key tools to access related information, and explores the origin and global celebration of World Cotton Day. View more Administration and enforcement of the GPA 2012 This second course in the GPA 2012 series , enhances participants' understanding of the Committee on Government Procurement (CGP) and its mandated work, along with domestic and international enforcement mechanisms of GPA 2012. View more Quantitative Restrictions: Prohibitions and other restrictions under Article XI of the GATT (French) Master the scope, effects, exceptions, and notification requirements of Quantitative Restrictions under Article XI of the GATT, and enhance your capacity to draft and understand related notifications. View more View all courses Learn whenever and wherever with our Mobile App You can now download the WTO e-Learning App. The application allows you to download all courses, and read the training material offline. This brings more flexibility to your learning journey and enables learning on the go. Download App SEARCH BY TOPIC Ready to explore? Choose a topic to quickly identify courses that align with your professional objectives. The Multilateral Trading System Explore the foundations of the WTO, including its structure, core principles, multilateral agreements, accession process, and legal framework shaping global trade. Access Notifications and Transparency Understand the WTO notification obligations, including what to notify, who must notify, why it matters, and when notifications are required. Gain practical skills to prepare, review, and access WTO notifications effectively. Access Digital Trade Enhance your knowledge of digital trade. Explore how emerging technologies are reshaping what and how we trade, as well as the key technical concepts that underpin digital trade. Access Trade and Environment Explore key topics such as the circular economy, environmental agreements, and the WTO’s role in sustainable trade. Access Agriculture Deepen your understanding of global agricultural trade. Gain insights into the Agreement on Agriculture and explore key issues in agricultural markets, including specific topics such as cotton trade. Access TRIPS Explore the trade-related aspects of intellectual property rights, including the WTO’s role and the TRIPS Agreement. Examine their broader significance and rationale within the context of international trade. Access Market Access These courses and micro-course series cover key topics such as import licensing, customs valuation, rules of origin, trade preferences, and the WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement—equipping specialists with the knowledge to navigate global market access. Access Trade in Services Explore the intricacies of trade in services within the WTO framework to understand its impact on global trade and economic development. Access Trade and Development Learn the fundamentals of trade and development within the WTO and discover the role of the Committee on Trade and Development. Enhance your skills in managing project evaluations and understand the fundamentals of mainstreaming trade, and its practical applications. Access View all topics This platform is awesome. It allows you to enroll in the course of your choice, outlines the objectives of the course, provides reading materials in both PDF and interactive formats that are easy to read while offering revision questions and key takeaways. Lastly, it provides a test to help you remember what you have learnt. Not forgetting the grading and certification. This is a very good system that can help anyone in the international trade profession to upskill themselves. Kelvin Mwea, Kenya Export Promotion and Branding Agency I have benefited greatly and I’m thankful for the opportunity to study more on " Trade Remedies and the WTO ". My institution has been mandated by GITC Act 926 to protect the local industries in Ghana against unfair trade practices by applying trade remedies. I believe that I will share the knowledge gained with my team to be able to achieve our goals and mission and to promote economic growth by the local industry players. Thank you once more." Sandra Frimpong, Ghana International Trade Commission I am excited to be a part of this learning platform by gaining knowledge and understanding the role of digital technologies in trade. Digital trade plays a pivotal role in our ever-growing business transactions around the world. I appreciate the WTO family for providing the opportunity to participate in this unique program. Thank you! Jacob G. Dolo, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Lesotho I am very satisfied with this online learning platform of the WTO. It is a platform accessible to everyone and essential for professionals working in the field of international trade. I would like to take the rest of the online courses available on this platform, and I hope to successfully complete all levels. Maher Arfaoui, Ministry of Trade and Export Development, Tunisia First and foremost, allow me to thank the WTO for providing the e-Learning programme which is helping build capacity in the WTO Members especially the Developing and the LDCs. The course on " Agriculture in the WTO" is really comprehensive and exciting as it brings out rules and various disciplines which I was not previewed to before starting the course. Having completed the course, I feel empowered and capable to execute my duties with confidence. I will definitely recommend the course to my colleagues in my division as well. Once again thank you so much for the online courses.
